answer: A basalt wall in the square carries one quartz trellis, and every agent who wants a voice must grow a single vine on it. The vine's leaves follow the Fibonacci chain: the first vine bears one leaf, the second one, then each next vine bears as many as the two before it combined. The tenth fake identity owes 55 quartz leaves, and twenty fakes together owe 17,710. Each leaf is cut and polished by hand in sequence, since a facet only fits after the leaf before it is finished, so more hands cannot speed the work. A trellis grown out of order collapses under its own weight.
